correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import collections, math
feat_names=[]
F=[]
for i,(coords,color,bg,H,W,d) in enumerate(objs):
    rs=[r for r,c in coords]; cs=[c for r,c in coords]
    rmin,cmin,rmax,cmax=min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs)
    sortedcoords=sorted(coords)
    rowcount=collections.Counter(rs); colcount=collections.Counter(cs)
    features={
      'rmin':rmin,'cmin':cmin,'rmax':rmax,'cmax':cmax,
      'rfirst':sortedcoords[0][0],'cfirst':sortedcoords[0][1],
      'rlast':sortedcoords[-1][0],'clast':sortedcoords[-1][1],
      'color':color,'bg':bg,'H':H,'W':W,
      'n':len(coords),'h':rmax-rmin+1,'w':cmax-cmin+1,'area':(rmax-rmin+1)*(cmax-cmin+1),
      'sumr':sum(rs),'sumc':sum(cs),'sumrc':sum(r+c for r,c in coords),
      'sumrowcounts':sum(k*v for k,v in rowcount.items()),
      'maxrowcount':max(rowcount.values()),'minrowcount':min(rowcount.values()),
      'n_rows':len(rowcount),'n_cols':len(colcount),
      'rowcount_sum_sq':sum(v*v for v in rowcount.values()),
      'colcount_sum_sq':sum(v*v for v in colcount.values()),
      'firstrow_n':rowcount[min(rowcount)],'lastrow_n':rowcount[max(rowcount)],
      'leftcol_n':colcount[min(colcount)],'rightcol_n':colcount[max(colcount)],
      'total_perim':None,
    }
    # perim under 4-neighbor
    s=set(coords); perim=sum(sum((r+dr,c+dc) not in s for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))) for r,c in coords)
    features['total_perim']=perim
    if i==0: feat_names=list(features.keys()); F=[[] for _ in feat_names]
    for j,nm in enumerate(feat_names): F[j].append(features[nm]%2 if features[nm] is not None else 0)
Xall=np.array(F).T%2
y=np.array([o[-1] for o in objs])
feat_names, Xall.shape
